thread:
sarah: Quick check — we have the annual planning weekend penciled for Fri–Sat next month. Can folks confirm whether we should keep it Friday evening kickoff + full Sat, or move activities to a single long Saturday? Looking for travel-minimizing option.

dan: I'd vote single long Saturday. Less overnight stays for folks traveling from the west coast.

sarah: @dan noted. main tradeoff is less time for deep working sessions and cross-team syncs.

ali: Single Saturday works for speakers, but we need 90min blocks for breakout workshops. If we compress, we lose 1 workshop.

jamie: Logistically Saturday-only reduces hotel blocks and cost. Catering will be tighter but doable. Also need earlier setup window for AV on Sat morning (we'll need volunteers for room checks).

maria: Heads up on timezone folks — a few APAC teammates asked for remote async options. Can we run one morning async prep and an afternoon hybrid deep-dive?

sarah: Good point @maria. Proposal: Friday evening optional async kickoff doc + lightweight social drop (remote threads), then Sat full-day in-person core sessions. That keeps most travel to a single night but preserves kickoff. Thoughts?

ali: That could work. For facilitation, I'm happy to run the product vision session if we keep it 60–75 min. Need a co-facilitator for the prioritization workshop.

Dan: I can co-facilitate the prioritization workshop with you @ali. I'll prepare the impact/cost matrix and run a quick pre-read.

sarah: Awesome. Volunteers for logistics/room ops on Sat morning? we need 2 people. @jamie are you able to lead and recruit 1 more?

jamie: Yep I can lead. @planning-bot please post sign-up for "setup crew" and remind 2 days prior. :white_check_mark:

planning-bot: Reminder created — signup link: https://intranet/recur/planning-setup. Auto-reminders scheduled 2 days before event.

maria: On accessibility: can we ensure captions for the hybrid room and record sessions for folks who can't attend? Also dietary needs for lunch. I'll pull the list.

sarah: Please. @maria can you own accommodations for APAC folks (late arrival/early departure)? we should allow remote-only participation for those who can't shift travel.

maria: Yep will coordinate.

sarah: Draft schedule (very rough):
```
08:00 — Setup & setup crew checks
09:00 — Welcome + company highlights (sarah)
10:00 — Product vision (ali) 60–75m
11:30 — Breakouts (teams) 90m
13:00 — Lunch
14:00 — Prioritization workshop (ali + dan) 120m
16:30 — Open sync & next steps 60m
18:00 — Close
```

sarah: If we do Friday optional kickoff, I'll post a one-pager and a 30-min optional hangout at 6pm.

dan: I'll sketch the prioritization rubric today and drop it in the shared doc.

ali: I'll prepare vision slides + a short prompt for breakouts. Need a projector and 1 wireless mic.

jamie: AV request submitted. Catering options: standard boxed lunch + 1 vegetarian/vegan/gluten-free option. Any other constraints?

sarah: Can people respond here with either "sat-only" or "fri+sat" and any major constraints? we'll close decision by EOD tomorrow.

maria: fri+sat (remote kickoff only) — prefer fewer travel nights for APAC but ok with the plan.

ali: sat-only.

dan: sat-only.

jamie: sat-only. I'll take setup rota.

sarah: Great — leaning sat-only with optional remote kickoff. I'll update calendar invites and post the kickoff doc. Thanks all :raised_hands:
